description.value: Creekside Coffee Factory is a neighbourhood café and in-house roastery in Coquitlam's Westwood area, roasting its own beans on-site and emphasising community warmth over chain-style efficiency. Customer reviews highlight a cozy, welcoming atmosphere well-suited to lingering — a handy stop on the Lougheed corridor for touring cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active café and in-house roastery at 3000 Lougheed Hwy #103 in Coquitlam, BC, corroborating the OSM phone number (604) 552-0522. The OSM 'community' field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website explicitly identifies the location as Coquitlam, BC — this is flagged as a concern. The website content does not mention bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any other amenity beyond the café experience itself, so all amenity fields are null.
concerns: OSM 'community' field records this as 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places the business in Coquitlam, BC (V3B 1A5 postal code). The OSM record may be geo-tagged or community-assigned incorrectly.
OSM addr:street uses 'Lougheed Highway' while the website uses 'Lougheed Hwy' — minor normalisation difference, not a substantive discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café confirmed via website with consistent address and phone. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists on the Lougheed Highway corridor.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood café and in-house roastery ... roasting its own beans on-site
